title: CAN Bus Sensor Communication Loss
causes: CAN transceiver bus fault; harness connector pin backout
actions: Inspect CAN bus termination resistance; reseat connector

title: Electronic Brake Actuator Failure
causes: Hydraulic pressure drop; solenoid valve coil open circuit
actions: Bleed brake hydraulic lines; replace actuator assembly

title: ABS System Major Fault
causes: Wheel speed sensor signal loss; hydraulic modulator failure
actions: Inspect wheel tone ring; scan ABS diagnostic codes

title: Sensor Plausibility Check Mismatch
causes: Conflicting speed inputs from left and right wheel sensors

title: ECU Fault Diagnostic Frame
causes: Internal electronic control unit error flag
